mysql_user.description: User account under which mysqld runs.

mysql_gid.description: Group ID for the MySQL user (often same as mysql_user).

mysql_datadir.description: Directory where MySQL stores its data files.

mysql_socket.description: Unix socket file for local connections.

mysql_bind_address.description: IP address to bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to accept all remote connections.

mysql_port.description: TCP/IP port number to listen on.

mysql_character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

mysql_collation_server.description: Default collation for new databases and tables.

mysql_time_zone.description: Default server time zone. Use 'SYSTEM' to inherit the OS time zone.

mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of InnoDB buffer pool (memory for caching data and indexes).

mysql_innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file.

mysql_innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in its own .ibd file.

mysql_innodb_flush_method.description: How InnoDB flushes data to disk (common values: fdatasync, O_DIRECT).

mysql_query_cache_type.description: Query cache mode (ON/OFF/DEMAND). Deprecated in MySQL 8.0+.

mysql_query_cache_size.description: Total size of query cache (set >0 to enable). Deprecated in MySQL 8.0+.

mysql_query_cache_limit.description: Maximum size of individual query results that can be cached.

mysql_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

mysql_max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of one packet or any generated/intermediate string.

mysql_thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep in cache for reuse.

mysql_general_log.description: Enable general query log (logs all statements).

mysql_general_log_file.description: Path to general query log file.

mysql_slow_query_log.description: Enable slow query log (logs queries taking longer than long_query_time).

mysql_slow_query_log_file.description: Path to slow query log file.

mysql_log_error.description: Path to error log file. Set to empty string to disable.

mysql_log_bin.description: Base name for binary log files (includes path, excludes extension).

mysql_binlog_format.description: Binary log format: STATEMENT, ROW, or MIXED.

mysql_expire_logs_days.description: Automatically purge binary logs older than this many days.

mysql_max_binlog_size.description: Maximum size of a single binary log file.

mysql_binlog_cache_size.description: Size of cache to hold binary log transactions.
